name: scaleup-patent-data-core
description: Offline-first evidence database for drug patent process scale-up research.

scripts.data:split: node src/cli.js split --input examples/curated_examples.jsonl --output data/processed/splits.json --seed fixture-12 --db data/curated/rxn2-demo.sqlite --dataset-version working-fixtures-v1
scripts.storage:check: docker compose run --rm api python scripts/hybrid_storage.py check
scripts.catalogue:init: docker compose run --rm api python scripts/bulk_pipeline.py init
scripts.catalogue:coverage: docker compose run --rm api python scripts/bulk_pipeline.py refresh-coverage
scripts.catalogue:summary: docker compose run --rm api python scripts/bulk_pipeline.py summary
scripts.api:test: docker compose run --rm api pytest -q apps/api/tests
